messages:
maya: Heads-up — compliance asked for a compact, exportable policy-change trail for tenant:acme-inc. They want who/when/why, but export size + PII are concerns. Any ideas for shape and UI?

kevin: Can we lean on a policy_fingerprint + actor_pseudonym instead of dumping full actor profiles? Add justification_id and a link to the console annotation. Keeps export small.

sasha: We have actorlink noise today. Proposal: export NDJSON lines with fields: policy_fp, change_ts, actor_pseud, justification_id, delta_snippet, affected_routes. Provide pseudonymization vs full modes.

emma: UX note — console should show an inline diff preview and an export request flow that estimates size and lets you toggle redaction before starting. Also require an approval step for high-sensitivity tenants.

maya: Also need sampling rules for high-volume policies — can't export every tiny tweak for infra routes. Suggest retention-lock for critical events and sampling for noisy actors.

kevin: Implementation idea: compute policy_fp = sha256(normalized_config). Store compact unified diff as delta_snippet. On export attach a signed "provenance bundle" manifest. Streaming exports are NDJSON with a bundle_id header.

sasha: Edge cases: if a rollout is in-progress we must include rollout_id + phase. Also store previous_state_snapshot_id so auditors can rehydrate the exact prior state.

kevin: Example NDJSON line (prototype):
```
{"bundle_id":"b-001","policy_fp":"f2c3d4...","ts":"2026-03-05T14:10:22Z","actor_pseud":"u:17","justification_id":"j-83","delta":"@@ -1 +1 @@\\n -routes: [a]\\n +routes: [a,b]","affected":["/v1/generate"],"sensitivity":"low"}
```

audit-bot: Export started: b-001 (requested by maya) — progress 0% :hourglass_flowing_sand:

emma: Quotas: exports must count against an "audit-exports" quota and have rate limits. Add a free export-preview that doesn't consume quota so compliance can validate shape.

kevin: Telemetry: tag each change event with an impact_score (est CPU/cost delta) so ops can prioritize what to surface in the console. Also add sampling_hint for very chatty actors.

sasha: Redaction modes: full | pseudonymized | minimal. Pseudonymized keeps actor_pseud + actor_hint. Minimal keeps actor_role only. UI should let you preview the pseudonymized snippet.

maya: We also want the console audit panel to show "revert" (one-click) which generates a signed revert request & records the justification. That revert should be included in exports too.

emma: I'll prototype quotas + estimated cost in the export preview. Who will own the API shape and signing?

kevin: I'll take API shape + signed bundle manifest. Sasha will own export UI + preview. Maya will draft compliance requirements and event retention. Emma picks up quotas/telemetry.

maya: Great — I'll open an RFC and capture these decisions.

audit-bot: Export completed: b-001, size 124KB, events: 12. Signed manifest sha256:abcd1234 :white_check_mark:
